text:
Noah P: Hey — I'm traveling and need to pick up an urgent prescription but the pharmacist says they need BIN/PCN/group numbers from my insurance card. I only have a photo of the front and it doesn't show those numbers. Can someone advise?
Benefits Team: Hi Noah 11 we can get that for you. Quick Qs: do you have your employee ID or the digital copy of the card? Also which pharmacy (chain/local)?
Noah P: I have the digital card PDF (front/back) but the back side is fuzzy. Pharmacy is CareScript on 5th Ave. Rx is an immediate course of antibiotics.
benefits-bot: Automated note: For prescriptions, pharmacies typically need BIN, PCN, Group ID, and the member ID. Our carrier (Atlas Health) lists BIN/PCN on the digital card in the member portal. If you cannot access the portal, contact benefits@redwood.com.
Priya S: Noah 11 two quick options: 1) We can pull the BIN/PCN/Group from the carrier and DM you the numbers right away (fastest). 2) If the pharmacist refuses to accept without a scannable card, you can pay out-of-pocket and file a reimbursement. For option 2, you need the itemized pharmacy receipt and the Rx label.
Pharmacy Admin: FYI CareScript can sometimes accept the following fields if BIN/PCN are missing: carrier name + member ID + Rx BIN placeholder. But that's inconsistent. If you DM the member ID to us we can try a real-time e-bill with CareScript on your behalf.
Noah P: Thanks. DMing now: member ID 987654321, DOB 1992-08-14. Would appreciate the numbers.
Benefits Team: Got it. Pulling carrier data now.
Benefits Team: Quick confirmation: carrier: Atlas Health, plan: Basic Care B (employee tier). Expected BIN/PCN/Group for this plan (do not share publicly):
```
BIN: 610012
PCN: RX1234
Group: REDWD-B
Carrier phone (if needed): 1-800-555-0199
```
Benefits Team: Please show that code block to the pharmacist or read the numbers. If CareScript still declines, pay and scan the receipt + Rx label and send to benefits@redwood.com with subject "Pharmacy reimbursement 11 Noah P".
Noah P: Pharmacist accepted the info over the phone and applied coverage. Saved a bunch — thank you! :relieved:
Benefits Team: Great. Note for records: we verified coverage and logged case #BR-8412. We'll also update your digital card image in the portal so the back is legible. If you prefer, we can add the BIN/PCN to your secure notes in the employee portal.
Noah P: That would be awesome 11 please add to secure notes.
Priya S: Done. Added masked BIN (***0012) to secure notes and flagged for a full image upload reminder. :white_check_mark:
benefits-bot: Reminder: If you pay out-of-pocket, reimbursement adjudication typically takes 7-14 business days once carrier receives documentation.
Noah P: Noted, thanks again everyone.
